theory.pairwise_prediction: under the same q(t), larger beta implies earlier optimal commitment
theory.qualitative_signature: cue quality may improve monotonically while behavioral cue responsiveness peaks at an intermediate stage

primary_empirical_signature.name: INTERMEDIATE_STAGE_CUE_RESPONSE_PEAK
required_ordering: cue quality/predictive accuracy must be estimated independently by stage
remaining response opportunity must decline or be independently bounded by stage
behavioral response to the cue must be measured on a common scale across at least three ordered stages
primary_empirical_signature.prediction: behavioral cue responsiveness is not maximized at the stage of maximal cue accuracy; it peaks earlier when information gain and remaining actionability are jointly high
falsifiers: cue-response strength increases monotonically through the terminal stage despite strongly declining independently measured recourse
cue-response strength is unrelated to independently estimated cue quality and recourse across stages
a q-only model predicts held-out behavior as well as or better than every prespecified q-plus-recourse model

strengths: departure decisions modeled at multiple sites
day length and accumulated temperature relevance changes en route
local accumulated temperatures at stopovers are used to adjust northward progression
required_new_work: recover or reconstruct stage-level departure data/model coefficients on one common scale
estimate stage-specific predictive accuracy of each cue for the declared later spring state
define recourse independently of the fitted cue-response outcome

candidate_systems.source: existing PAYOFF-B registered GPS cue-uptake lane
strengths: 75 GPS-tracked birds in 2019-2023 in the registered Movebank study
historical route-to-Bylot predictive-connectivity machinery already specified
required_new_work: prespecify an independent remaining-recourse proxy before opening focal outcomes
retain the existing no-retuning rule for cue definitions and route contexts

strengths: signed phase errors span early and late starts
early animals decelerate/use longer stopovers and late animals accelerate/use shorter stopovers
strong route-level phase compression is published
required_new_work: source-row access for a stagewise reanalysis
do not infer q from the same phase-correction outcome used as response

prohibited_direct_substitutions: 1-|lambda| == theoretical r without a prespecified loss/action mapping
licensed_proxies_for_directional_tests: remaining route length or number of decision stages as geometry-only proxies
remaining feasible timing window from independently measured biological constraints
ratio of restricted-action to full-action information value when both loss surfaces are measured
recourse_identification.preferred_direct_definition: r_t = V_restricted(q_ref,t) / V_full(q_ref) at a prespecified reference cue quality q_ref on a common loss scale

model_comparison.focal_model: cue quality plus recourse/actionability interaction specified before outcome inspection
model_comparison.strongest_test: held-out prediction of stage-specific behavior or commitment under a preregistered common response scale

claim_boundary.allowed: the actionability-balance model makes a falsifiable intermediate-stage response prediction and identifies data requirements for a direct natural test
not_allowed: existing natural data already validate t*
migrants universally have higher r than plants or pollinators
generic optimal stopping or value of information is novel
